title: TargetAttributionV1 — Plan-bound sidecar INPUT for resolved target endpoints (DRAFT, isolated successor)
description: Typed separate INPUT record. It is NOT a native fact payload field and MUST NOT be added to foundation/relation-payload-schemas.v2.json $defs. Bound to PlanId + source fact2 + the producing provider closure. Points at the fact; the fact has no backlink (no cycle). Identity is raw SHA-256 of C(this record); not an H-domain. Provider attribution truth is trusted after host join validation. First-party inventory lookup MAY derive an equivalent record when unambiguous; otherwise this sidecar or kind/occupancy unknown. Never parse SubjectIdV1 spelling to invent kind or occupancy. Standing: draft only; frozen21 and live repo untouched. Root owns ProofInputRef domain integration.

planId.description: The Plan whose evaluation consumes this input. Closure requires the named fact2 to belong to this Plan's views. planId is a locator, not hashed as a parent into EnumerationPlanV1.

sourceFactId.description: The native fact whose target endpoint this record attributes. Unique with planId: at most one TargetAttributionV1 per (planId, sourceFactId).

producerClosure.description: Must equal the source fact's producerClosure. The named closure must be Plan-selected. This is the trusted attribution producer, not a second fact mint.

targetUniverse.description: Bare 64-hex suffix of the TARGET endpoint universe. Must equal sourceFact.targetUniverse. Never silently swapped with sourceUniverse.

targetNativeId.description: Exact native target identity copied from the fact payload's resolved target-id field (resolvedTarget / resolvedBinding / resolvedCallee / to / reachable). Compare this to the current evaluation subject's nativeSubjectId BEFORE kind/occupancy: a different nativeId is a known nonmatch even if kind is unknown.

kind.description: Stored kinds are file|symbol|package. unknown is explicit metadata, not a fourth subject kind and not export. export is NOT a token here.

occupancy.description: first-party: targetNativeId is a first-party inventory subject of targetUniverse. external: attributed outside first-party inventory. unknown: producer/host could not decide. unknown occupancy is NOT occupancy=external and is NOT a false match.

exported.description: Tri-state for kind=symbol only (same tokens as subject-inventory InventoryRowV1.exported). MUST be null when kind is file, package, or unknown.

logicalPath.description: Optional ONLY when occupancy is external or unknown. MUST be null when occupancy=first-party (path lives on the inventory row). Never an invented first-party snapshot path for an external target.

proofInputRef.standing: NEW, pending root ProofInputRef / byDomain integration

x-opensip-join-law.standing: Host validates; provider kind/occupancy/exported truth is trusted after joins succeed.
joins: sourceFactId is a fact2 of that Plan
producerClosure equals fact.producerClosure and is Plan-selected
targetNativeId equals the payload field named by evaluator-projection-registry.v1.json relations[fact.relation].targetNativeIdField at fact.resolution
occupancy=first-party implies targetNativeId is a nativeSubjectId in some SubjectInventoryV1 of that Plan whose universe (via EnumerationPlan program binding) equals targetUniverse
occupancy=first-party and kind in {file,symbol,package} implies that inventory row's kind equals this kind
logicalPath when present is not required to be in the snapshot inventory (external/unknown only)

derivation.when: endpoint=target evaluation of a fact whose targetNativeIdField is present, and exactly one SubjectInventoryV1 row of this Plan has nativeSubjectId=targetNativeId under a program binding whose universe equals fact.targetUniverse
derivation.action: host MAY materialize this record with occupancy=first-party, kind=that row.kind, exported=row.exported or null, logicalPath=null, producerClosure=fact.producerClosure
derivation.otherwise: require a retained sidecar, or evaluate kind/occupancy as unknown. NEVER parse namespace:opaque SubjectIdV1 spelling.

x-opensip-join-law.absence: Missing sidecar when derivation is not unambiguous is metadata unknown: not nomatch, not false. Different targetNativeId vs current nativeSubjectId is known nomatch even if kind/occupancy unknown.
x-opensip-join-law.noBacklink: fact2 descriptors are unchanged. This record names sourceFactId; no fact field names an attribution digest.

x-opensip-new-internal-faults.standing: NEW/internal pending root public-detail / D9 route-registry integration. Not existing DomainDetailCode members.
